records.rationale: All unique remerge hunks read, including corrections outside conflict markers. Makefile: Unique non-conflict hunk restores historical depmod mixed-tree argument. Adapted current native one-argument depmod script is retained: pinned Kleaf copies base outputs into OUT_DIR and sets KBUILD_MIXED_TREE=OUT_DIR, and modules_install invokes depmod explicitly using mixed System.map. Existing full emulator workflow succeeds without restoring obsolete argument count. Keep mixed-tree validation, symvers import and current build conditional fixes. drivers/pwm/core.c: Keep whole native PWM core, not old PWM_OUTPUT_FIXED extension or obsolete initial polarity assignment. SDK CONFIG_PWM is off; implementation is physical PWM output support, not a current emulator interface. drivers/scsi/ufs/ufs-sysfs.c: Current relocated drivers/ufs/core/ufs-sysfs.c is entirely native, including correctly spelled helper. Historical UFS-specific hook include is part of documented physical-device hook exclusion; generic UFS drivers remain available. SDK actually enables UFS drivers, so exclusion is not justified by claiming CONFIG_SCSI_UFSHCD=n; the added UFS hardware customization is outside ordinary SDK virtual storage. No future physical-device hook implementation added. kernel/.gitignore: Whole native ignore file retained, with current anchored generated artifacts. Historical timeconst/hz locations need not be reintroduced; this is metadata, no runtime permission effect. kernel/sched/fair.c: Restore native LBF_ACTIVE_LB while preserving src_rq_rf for vendor migration callback, fixing preceding merge omission. Both fields verified in current active-load-balance initializer. mm/cma.c: Keep module export support and current multi-range allocation retry in cma_range_alloc. Native spin_lock_irqsave/irqrestore preserves caller IRQ state; sleeping retry occurs after unlock and only when blocking GFP is permitted, no fatal signal and no NORETRY. Prior 57131aee4cb9 adaptation keeps native GFP/compound/range/zone contracts instead of historical mutex or unconditional IRQ enable. CMA enabled with size zero; exact runtime reservation remains unconfirmed, not an omission rationale.
